items.text: phimint is built on phi-agent - docs: https://docs.phiagent.dev/
Type @ to reference a file in your message, / for commands
Press Ctrl+O to fold or unfold the thinking panel
Enter sends your message, Ctrl+J starts a new line without sending
Press Ctrl+C once to cancel the running task
Press Ctrl+C twice to quit when idle
Press Ctrl+Y to copy the last reply
Press Ctrl+V to paste a screenshot - the terminal keeps Cmd+V
Press Ctrl+L to redraw the screen if the display looks wrong
Scroll history with the mouse wheel or fn+Up/Down
Run /model to switch provider and model mid-session
Run /upgrade to check for a newer phimint release
Press Ctrl+P to open the session picker and resume past work
